title: Secret in a framework or file context (shell) — review required
description: A secret is embedded in a shell context: [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*(?:KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD)s*=s*S+. Context-shaped secrets (framework keys, connection strings, config values) ship to checkouts and artifacts like any hardcoded value. This lexical rule flags the embedding; the reviewer confirms it is a placeholder or externalizes it.
remediation: Load the value from the process environment, never the file and rotate the embedded one.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches embedded values regardless of liveness. Generic secret assignments are separate rules.

tests.line: # verified: # STRIPE_SECRET is set in env
